notes.title: Shareware Release and Door 407 Developer Bundle at a discount!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=M_prXJHRiUA;full][/previewyoutube]
Yarr, pirates!

It’s time to lead a rebellion in the name of the Queen of Samreignia (self-proclaimed)! Get a peek at what Diplomacy is Not an Option in this free prequel. Fight for the Kingdom - and a hefty reward - in a small campaign, or for your own survival in an Endless Mode map! 

Additionally, you can purchase all our games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40793/Door_407_Developer/]in the Door 407 Developer bundle[/url] at 50% discount till May 7th!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]

notes.title: DiNaO: Shareware Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216325/ccbdfc0d9762a8e009dcf1d04f6e642e0efe3284.png[/img]
Pupultas!

You probably noticed that there’s been no news about Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware for a long time. The truth is: we’ve been quietly working on it in between making the Undead story branch, Map Editor, new Endless maps and Challenges.

Soon you’ll learn how Samreignia earned its independence and how Milord’s grandfather became a noble, as we are finally ready to announce its release date. [b]The free prequel will become available on April 30th![/b]

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]
